title: Contribution
description: Generic Blackboard contribution wrapper. Two concrete shapes (SourceContribution, TargetContribution) distinguished by the host Blackboard instance: a TargetContribution (panel hosted on the Target Blackboard: Definition/Archetype/Statement) adds `targetIdentityKey`, a SourceContribution (panel hosted on the Source Blackboard: Pack-namespaced names) does not. Engine attaches id / contributorKsId / derivedFrom / timestamp / cacheKey. KSs cannot fabricate them. Contributions are immutable and append-only; a slot's `contributions` list is the run-time log within a Run. Wave 9: every Contribution MAY carry an optional `evidence` array of EvidenceRef entries (replaces the dropped Evidence panel); the per-Contribution `confidence` value (already mandatory) replaces the dropped Confidence panel for synthesis purposes (use `ConfidenceSynthesisKS` to post a refined Statement Contribution whose `confidence` reflects the synthesis).

id.description: Engine-set unique id. Stable handle for derivedFrom graphs and audit.

panel.description: Host panel name. Engine-owned Target Blackboard panels: `Definition`, `Archetype`, `Statement`. Source Blackboard panels: any Pack-namespaced name from a registered Pack manifest (e.g. `itip:SourceUnit`). The dropped Granularity/Evidence/Confidence panels (Wave 9 removal) are no longer accepted.

slot.description: Slot name within `panel` (one of the keys of the panel's closed `slots` map). Engine validates `post` against the JSON Schema bound to this key.

targetIdentityKey.description: Required for TargetContribution (host panel on the Target Blackboard: Definition/Archetype/Statement). Null/absent for SourceContribution (host panel on the Source Blackboard: Pack-namespaced names).

post.description: Panel-specific payload posted on the Blackboard (validated against the JSON Schema bound to `slot` in the panel's slots map).

contributorKsId.description: Versioned gsmarc:// URI of the producer (KS or Pack Instructions Provider). The provenance class is read from the URI prefix; a reserved engine URI identifies the Initializer (gsmarc://gsm-sourcer/initializer/v1).

confidence.description: Producer's self-rated credibility for this single post, in [0, 1]. Mandatory; deterministic structural posts conventionally set 1.0. Read by the highestConfidence resolver and by ConfidenceSynthesisKS as input to a synthesised refined Contribution. Wave 9: the dropped `Confidence` panel previously held a per-identity synthesised score; that role is now played by the `confidence` value of a refined Statement Contribution posted by ConfidenceSynthesisKS and folded by the `compose` resolver on Statement.Draft.

rationale.description: Optional free-text explanation. Surfaced in audit trails.

cacheKey.description: Required when the producing KS declares determinismDefault = NON_DETERMINISTIC in its descriptor (I-4). Stable hash of (contributorKsId, all read inputs); lets the engine memoise LLM calls across iterations and Run replays. Determinism is a property of the KS implementation (KnowledgeSourceDescriptor.determinismDefault), not of an individual Contribution.

derivedFrom.description: Ids of Contributions the producer read to produce this one. Engine-set; used for audit and lineage reconstruction.

evidence.description: Optional list of EvidenceRef entries supporting (or contradicting) this Contribution's claim. Wave 9 replacement for the dropped `Evidence` panel: any KS that has evidence to attach MAY embed it here on the Contribution it posts. Read by ConfidenceSynthesisKS via `BlackboardView.contributionsOf(Statement, identity)` followed by `c.evidence()`.

source.description: Optional gsmarc:// or other URI identifying the evidence's origin (e.g. a SourceFreeze reference, a test-result artefact, an LLM-trace id).

weight.description: Signed signal strength in [-1, 1]; negative weights are contradictory evidence.

timestamp.description: Wall-clock posting time. Required by the firstWriter resolver and by audit ordering. Engine-set.
